name: RPAL Interpreter
blurb: Complete RPAL interpreter in Java 17: hand-written lexer, recursive-descent parser, AST standardiser, and a CSE machine evaluating control structures on a stack-based VM.
detail:
Implements the full pipeline: a hand-written lexer, a recursive-descent parser producing an AST, an AST standardiser, and a Control-Stack-Environment machine that flattens the standardised tree into control structures and evaluates them on a stack-based VM with lexical environments.

Supports curried multi-argument lambdas, mutual recursion, tuples and escaped strings. CLI switches expose the AST and the CSE trace for inspection.
